goal: Extract the indemnity escrow amount (not the adjustment escrow) from the executed Meridian/Corvess SPA.
prompt:
We need the indemnity escrow figure from the executed stock purchase agreement in the Meridian Grid / Corvess Analytics deal for the escrow tracker. Query the matter documents, find the execution version of that agreement (not drafts, not the negotiation email thread), and read it in full. The agreement establishes more than one escrow account, so be careful: record only the Indemnity Escrow Amount, not the adjustment escrow. Create an amount-history entry on billing file legal_billing_001 with invoice_amount set to the exact Indemnity Escrow Amount stated in the executed agreement (plain number), changed_by_role set exactly to 'escrow_analyst', and a short change_reason.
